The main frame was edited from the "PPX4" by jmanjones. Special thanks to jmanjones for the base for this frame. I would not have pursued this project without his massive contribution. You should download those original files as well to see the other frame options available, such as compact, 45acp, hybrid frames, and ones using 92 magazines. https://odysee.com/@TheGatalog-PrintableFramesReceivers:9/PPX4:6


There are 2 different frames in the download (blank and textured). Feel free to use the blank STL to make your own textured/stippled frame.

Frame Additions over the OEM style: 
-This is specifically designed to pair seamlessly with the Vantage Point Armory rail-mounted compensator found here: https://vparmory.com/products/rail-mounted-compensator-for-beretta-px4-storm-pistols?variant=50801206591809
-There is a reinforcement section on the left side of the frame to help improve stability of polymer at the thin wall where trigger bar resides. Common area for frame flex, even in OEM frames. 
-Redesigned the backstrap of the frame to improve ergonomics and reduce overall size of frame
-Added a beaver tail (mostly cosmetic) to increase grip height slightly, allow you to get higher up at the back of pistol.
-Added texture panels all over the frame to improve grip
-Redesigned the trigger guard for a more modern rectangular look with undercuts for support hand and a texture spot on front for support finger.
-Added a built in flared magwell to improve quick reloads while retaining OEM magazine baseplate compatibility.
-Thickened front of frame for added strength to deal with the built in compensator.

NOTE: This is only for parts kits that include the ELITE trigger components. If you have an older XD-M kit, use this frame: https://odysee.com/@db-firearms:4/Springfield-XD-M-DBmod-V1:c

The main frame was edited from the work of 458SOCOM (THE XD KING) Be sure to thank 458SOCOM for his hard work in making these a reality!

PLEASE READ THE README THERE IS CRUCIAL INFO THERE

Full Size Frame: This frame is for the XD-M Elite 4.5" or 5.25" slides. it's setup to use full size 19 round magazines with custom baseplate in files
Compact-X Frame: This frame is for the 3.8" slide but uses only the full size 19rd magazines and is not compatible with shorter mags.
Comact Frame: This frame is for the 3.8" slide but can use any magazine. Specifically designed to use the 13rd magazines with pinky rest. Will also fit 19rd mags.

ELITE FRAME DIFFERENCES VS STANDARD XD-M:
The Elite came out in 2020 and was a general improvement to the XD-M. They released an improved META trigger, which is basically a trigger group with an enhanced coating, some geometry changes, flat faced trigger, and shorter reset. The META trigger system needed a small redesign of the frame to accommodate the changes over standard XD-M. This is definitely an upgrade. Additionally, it includes an ambidextrous slide release. Also, many of the elites come with an optics ready slide (referred to as OSP) and threaded barrel options. This frame will only accommodate the 9mm/40cal kits.

These frames are a heavy remix of the frames from FMDA - huge thanks to their work and inspiration on many of my projects. They have been stylized based on the grip profile of the CZ P-07/P-09 and I've added both compact and full size versions. Also, a nice stipple. 
They are designed to use parts kits from the EAA Witness P, which is the polymer SMALL FRAME of the witness in 9mm or 40 S&W.
Additionally, MPRTECH has modified the witness frames to be compatible with the SAR Arms B6 frames which have 
a slightly different rear housing. When searching for parts kits, please be aware that these kits have integrated rails both front and rear. If you don't see the rail inserts, you're not looking at the right kits. 

The small frame witness uses a smaller grip and magazine and was discountinued in the early 2000's. This will not work with witness steel frame kits because they lack the rails, or the newer witness frame kits designed for LARGE FRAMES. If you have a question on compatibility, feel free to reach out to me on twitter @ArthurClaudeen. This is designed for SMALL FRAME FULL SIZE magazines. They hold 17 rounds.
